parameters.query: SELECT id, name, etsy_shop_id, oauth_token, refresh_token, token_expires, COALESCE(last_synced_at, created_at) AS watermark FROM shops WHERE oauth_token IS NOT NULL AND etsy_shop_id IS NOT NULL;
INSERT INTO orders (shop_id, etsy_order_id, status, total, raw, line_items) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (etsy_order_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, shop_id, etsy_order_id;
UPDATE shops SET oauth_token = $1, refresh_token = $2, token_expires = $3, last_synced_at = now() WHERE id = $4;

meta.description: Cron (15 min). For each connected shop: refresh-if-needed, fetch paid receipts since shops.last_synced_at, INSERT new orders (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), dispatch each new order to wf 07 (POD routing) — wf 07 no-ops on non-POD orders. Persists token rotation + watermark per shop.
